comments.content: JGM_ROOT is derived at runtime via resolve(import.meta.dir, ".."), but it is compared against git pathnames returned by collectHealth() (git rev-parse / worktree list, which yield absolute, normalized paths). If import.meta.dir is resolved through a symlink or a normalization that differs from the literal JGM_ROOT hardcoded in health.ts ("/home/leviathan/JARVIS_WORKSPACE/Shared_Workspace/Jarvis_Git_Manager"), the startsWith/equality checks below will fail to match legitimate worktrees under the Jarvis_Git_Manager workspace, silently dropping their adopt notes. This is a latent false-negative: the daemon's whole purpose is to record adopt notes for product|leftover rows, so missed matches are a correctness issue. Either hardcode JGM_ROOT to the same absolute literal used in health.ts, or normalize both sides (e.g. via realpathSync) before the startsWith/=== comparisons. Note that PLUTUS_AGENT and GI_DIR come from health.ts and are already normalized absolute paths, so they are fine; only JGM_ROOT is at risk.
